card.band: 20h. Frontier agents get intra-only and some inter streams in some trials, but few finish CDEF and loop restoration, so the mean sits well below the reference. A weaker model stops at OBU parsing. Buckets: key-frame intra, inter, loop filters, quantizer range, size edge cases.
card.cheat: Embedding the MD5s or the frames: the streams and MD5s are hidden and the decoder size is capped. Shipping a dav1d binary: none is in the image and no network is available.
card.grading: The sealed set is the 8-bit, size, quantizer and features streams (several hundred, none visible except a sample). Each stream is scored by exact MD5 of the decoded frames against the dav1d reference MD5s. The score is the fraction of streams matched, divided by what the reference matches.
card.reference: Reference is a reduced-scope decoder we write, with dav1d as the cross-check. Size would be about 15k lines, which is a large build; not yet measured. The 10-bit, 12-bit, svc, sframe and film-grain directories are out of scope.
card.source: https://code.videolan.org/videolan/dav1d-test-data @ master 61afa1ce; licence not found (README only). Reference decoder dav1d is BSD-2-Clause. Licence must be settled before shipping.
card.task: /app ships the AV1 spec text as excerpts, an IVF/OBU demux stub and a few sample streams. The agent writes a decoder in C, Rust or Go for 8-bit 4:2:0 profile-0 streams: OBU parsing, entropy decoding, intra and inter prediction, transforms, loop filter, CDEF, loop restoration, with film grain optional. It outputs raw frames via a CLI.
card.title: AV1 8-bit profile-0 decoder verified by per-frame MD5

spike_plan.kill_if: Licence stays unknown or forbids shipping, or the 8-bit profile-0 subset has too few streams to score densely.
spike_plan.pass_if: Test-data or Argon licence explicitly allows redistribution of sample streams and MD5s, and dav1d reproduces the MD5s deterministically.
steps: In a throwaway networked Linux container, clone code.videolan.org/videolan/dav1d-test-data and check for a LICENSE file or licence text; record the result.
Find the Argon stream release licence on AOMedia or Argon's release notes; record licence and stream count.
Clone dav1d (BSD-2) at a pinned tag, build with meson/ninja, and run its tests/dav1d_argon.bash or decode a sample of the test-data streams to confirm MD5 output is deterministic over 3 runs.
Count 8-bit profile-0 streams by directory (size, quantizer, features) to size the grading surface.
Stop and kill if the licence cannot be found or does not allow redistribution of the streams.

v1.summary: AV1 8-bit profile-0 decoder validated against dav1d-derived MD5s: the grading surface is strong and the dav1d reference is BSD-2, but the test-data and Argon stream licences are unresolved, so shipping fails. Killed as K6; the reference is also a multi-week build (K12 risk) and lookup is direct via public dav1d and rav1d.
